description: Compare attacking a debt with investing the difference and find the break-even return that decides it.
Run snowball and avalanche payoff orders against the same three debts and compare interest and payoff months.
Project a monthly SIP with an optional lumpsum, annual step-up and inflation-adjusted value.
Model dividend reinvestment and see how compounding shares, dividend growth and price gains build a position.
Compute WACC from equity, debt and preferred weights with the tax shield and an implied enterprise value.
